mechanicalValidation.verdict: structurally sound; matches A3 mechanical result

formulaDisposition.a2HostTermination: accepted as total controllable exit input
formulaDisposition.note: A1 turn-4 formula was under-specified the same way as A3's. Durability, interruption, pre-admission, query/mutation/serve are required. Item 37 restates as: HostTermination is host-only; one map to exitCode; one process-boundary write site.

peerReviewResponses.question: Snapshot invalidation after bounded convergence is indeterminate rather than operational-failed.
peerReviewResponses.requiredRefinement: indeterminate.reasonCodes MUST include at least: convergence-exhausted | required-coverage-missing | fingerprint-recipe-unsupported | required-provider-unavailable (open set, append-only).

peerReviewResponses.question: Addressed missing identity vs empty collection query.
peerReviewResponses.requiredRefinement: request-rejected.errorCode distinguishes never-existed vs expired/retention-collected vs unresolvable-resolver.

peerReviewResponses.question: Optional egress diagnostic-only; required delivery operational-failed.
peerReviewResponses.requiredRefinement: CommandEnvelope must project termination and analysis verdict as distinct fields; docs must say exit 4 with verdict=pass means postcondition failure, not policy fail.

peerReviewResponses.question: Authorized ephemeral may return success but cannot back baseline/CI/replay.
peerReviewResponses.requiredRefinement: Authoritative durability as requiredPostcondition + ephemeral Plan => request-rejected before work (golden analysis-ephemeral-when-authoritative-required). CI must declare authoritative; exit 0 alone is never an attestation.

findingsOnA3Review.title: Baseline unsupported recipe must be indeterminate
findingsOnA3Review.detail: A3 is correct that C4/F3 is a sealed product property missing from the golden set. Mass net-new as policy-failed is the ratchet-wolf failure. Merge golden baseline-compare-unsupported-recipe -> indeterminate/3. Also list fingerprint-recipe-unsupported under reasonCodes.

findingsOnA3Review.title: Interrupt during authoritative publication
findingsOnA3Review.detail: Exit stays interrupted/130. Add invariant: interruption or crash during authoritative publication leaves ledger recoverable; recovery marks orphan abandoned, never sealed success. Cross-ref sealed crash-recovery / C5.

findingsOnA3Review.title: Serve graceful stop maps to success
findingsOnA3Review.decision: For commandKind=serve, cooperative SIGINT/SIGTERM that completes cleanup maps to success/0. Mid-request cancel of an in-flight tool call may still surface interrupted to the protocol client, but the process exit after clean transport teardown is success. Generic user-interrupt golden remains for analysis/query/mutation only (commandKind != serve).
findingsOnA3Review.rationale: MCP/server lifecycle is stop-by-signal; 130 as default makes supervisors false-alarm. Document SuccessExitStatus only as optional ops note, not the primary contract.

findingsOnA3Review.title: latest resolver on empty domain is request-rejected
findingsOnA3Review.decision: expectedClass request-rejected / 2 with errorCode RESOLVER.EMPTY_DOMAIN (or never-existed subclass). Not success-with-null for CLI exit purposes.
findingsOnA3Review.rationale: Caller asked to address one run identity via resolver; resolution failed. Agents should fix the request (run analysis first or pass explicit id), not treat as successful empty search. Envelope may still include a structured empty domain diagnostic.

findingsOnA3Review.title: Ledger busy timeout is operational-failed
findingsOnA3Review.detail: errorCode must distinguish LEDGER.BUSY_TIMEOUT (retryable) from LEDGER.CORRUPT (repair).

d1Item38.rule: Contributions emit observed scores / non-authoritative recommendations only. Effective severity, gates, waivers, baseline scope, required Coverage are project intent. Severity mapping pinned in opensip.lock with contribution identity so upgrades cannot silently re-escalate.

d5SchemaIdentity.rule: Do not call the target envelope CommandEnvelope/v1 if shipping CommandOutcome v1 collides. Use distinct schema family URI + major (e.g. opensip.command-envelope family major 1) with dual-projection during D19. Header carries family+major; consumers pin or get request-rejected.

d19Slice1.rule: Slice 1 may land as internal parity adapters now. Do not freeze public ProjectDescriptor/ResolvedConfig/Envelope ABI until D5/D13/D14 artifacts exist. Exit contract v1.1 can freeze earlier as host-internal finalizer input.

process.sealedPropertiesCovered: ACCEPT A3 proposal — every future artifact must list sealedPropertiesCovered[] referencing prior consensus items (e.g. C4, C5, item 38) so reviews catch silent drops.
process.nextArtifact: opensip.d9-exit-contract v1.1 merges accepted goldens + invariants; supersedes candidate-agent-2 for implementation binding once peers ack.

overall: v1 candidate is the right shape (HostTermination total union). Not implementation-bound until v1.1 incorporates C4 baseline, serve stop, empty latest, busy ledger, ephemeral authority, and reasonCode/errorCode refinements.
